text:
natalie: trying to cut the sdk-js release for the sample app and regendiff is blocking publish. It flags a minor bump because example JSON property order changed in a generated file.

sam: can you paste the diff?

natalie: sure, top of regendiff:```diff
-  examples:
-    - name: default
-      value: {
-        "role": "user",
-        "content": "hey"
-      }
+  examples:
+    - name: default
+      value: {
+        "content": "hey",
+        "role": "user"
+      }
```This looks like only key order in the example object changed. No surface types changed.

leo: that's the new json-stable-stringify patch in typegen. We switched to alphabetical keys for determinism which reordered nested example objects. I thought regendiff normalized JSON though?

regendiff-bot: Automated report: regen diff in packages/sdk-js/src/generated/examples/ChatExamples.ts. Change class: docs/examples. Semver-impact computed: minor (typegen diff rule).

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #401 failed at regendiff gate. log: `semver-check: candidate minor bump detected`.

sam: short-term options: (A) mark this diff as docs-only via a manual override in the release UI, (B) adjust regendiff to canonicalize example objects before computing semantic diff, (C) patch typegen to preserve example ordering when source includes explicit example ordering metadata. Which one is lowest friction?

natalie: (A) fastest to unblock but manual override needs an approver in release team. (B) is ideal and low-risk
 but requires a small change in dev-tools. (C) is nicer but more invasive.

leo: I'll prototype B now: add a canonicalizer that parses any `examples` block and sorts keys inside values for comparison only. That way ordering-only changes won't count as API diffs.

sam: also add a comment marker support: if generated files contain `// regendiff: ignore-example-order` then regendiff will treat ordering diffs as noise. Useful for transitional rollouts.

natalie: ok if you push a quick PR I can request release approver meanwhile. We need publish today.

leo: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/210 created with canonicalizer + comment marker handling. Includes unit tests for nested objects and arrays.

regendiff-bot: Note: new commit 9a7cde in dev-tools. Running regendiff with updated toolchain...

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #402 re-run. Regendiff step now reports "examples-only ordering change ignored" and no semver bump detected.

natalie: great, I'll continue with `yarn lerna publish from-package` and ping release approver to confirm.

sam: follow-ups: add entry to release docs explaining that examples order are not considered semver-impacting; add an audit for any other generated docs that may trigger semver gates.

natalie: filing follow-up ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/issues/131 - ensure regendiff canonicalization covers example arrays and nested maps.

leo: note for future: we should coordinate typegen default stringify behavior with the pipeline. If we prefer stable alphabetical keys, the canonicalizer must be permanent to avoid churn.

ci-bot: publish pipeline #402 passed. Artifacts uploaded.

natalie: publish completed. thanks team! :party_parrot:
